on shaded days, summer time: add 1 hour
HEIGHTS IN METRES ABOVE CHART DATUM (the Shom's zéro hydrographique). Mean level at DIEPPE: 5.14 m. High waters in black, low waters in grey.
TIMES IN UTC+1, standard (winter) time, in four figures. On shaded days, summer time: add 1 hour. The clocks change on 31 March and 27 October, in red.
coef: the French tidal coefficient of each high water at Brest, with the time of that high water under it, in this page's time. It runs from 20 to 120 for the whole coast.
The coefficient is what you enter the Shom tidal stream atlas with: take the one whose Brest time is nearest yours. Moon: ● new · ◐ first quarter · ○ full · ◑ last quarter.
Harmonic constants analysed from REFMAR observations (Shom), Licence Ouverte 2.0. Not for navigation.
